ambient: A thought is cut for time and lands better.
The room packs down another notch.
description: The room is being folded down towards the beat, and everything in it's getting shorter, including the distance to the walls and the amount of time a thought is allowed. It's hilarious. It's also happening quite fast now.
name: The Compression

looks: Closer on every beat, and not in a threatening way.
They're being packed rather than moved.
There's a great deal less room, and you haven't needed any of it.
objects.name: the walls

looks: It was going to be enormous. It has been cut for time.
You get the last third of it, on the beat, and it's funnier that way.
It fits inside a single throb now, which is efficient.
objects.name: what's left of the thought
